thread:
mel: Drafting a new Grafana board for the Sentinel healthscore — combines ECC/Xid spikes, corrected ECC rate, thermal excursions, card evictions, and recent perf-degradation signals. Feedback wanted before I flip it to main. Preview: <https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abcd1234|grafana: sentinel-gpu-health>

ajay: Love the idea. Can we include per-region cardinality (num cards reporting) and a per-model/request-weighted view? Some customers skew health by model hotpaths.

kat: Agree re weighting. Also we should define SLOs: e.g. P99 inference availability vs card-level degradation. What thresholds are you thinking for the score -> alert mapping? :thinking_face:

mel: Sketch thresholds in the draft: score 0-1 normalized (1 best). Propose: >=0.95 green, 0.9-0.95 yellow, <0.9 red emergency. Yellow => page to oncall only if sustained >15m or if cluster capacity < 1.5x. Red => immediate page + auto-canary fallback for affected region.

mel: Quick PromQL examples I slapped into the panel queries:
```
# ECC corrected rate per GPU (5m)
rate(nvidia_ecc_corrected_total{job="gpu-exporter"}[5m])

# Xid errors (5m count)
sum(increase(nvidia_xid_errors_total{job="gpu-exporter"}[5m])) by (gpu_card_id)

# Simple healthscore (example, normalize metrics beforehand)
1 - clamp_min((0.4*norm_ecc + 0.3*norm_xid + 0.2*norm_temp + 0.1*norm_evictions), 0)
```

jordan: For alerting, let's not page on single Xid unless it's repeated across >2 cards in a rack or >3 distinct hosts. We had a noisy rack last month that triggered tons of pages.

lia: Can we add a panel for KV cache hit ratio + prefix cache evictions? Some perf degradations we saw were cache-related, not card hardware.

ajay: Also add a small table for model routing fallbacks (how often we routed to CPU or lower-capacity pool) — useful for correlating customer impact.

kat: On SLOs — recommend two tracks: (1) operator SLO for mean time to detect + respond to degraded cards (target MTTR < 30m for red incidents), (2) customer-facing availability SLO (95/99 targets by tier) that maps to routing fallback SLA.

infra-bot: dashboard "sentinel-gpu-health-v1" updated by mel at 2024-06-15T09:12:30Z :white_check_mark:

mel: Thanks — action items I will take: (a) add per-region cardinality and model-weight panels, (b) wire canary fallback metric into routing dashboard, (c) prototype alerting rules with 15m and 60m windows for yellow/red, (d) run 2-week shadow alerting and collect false-positive rate. Will ping when ready for oncall trial.

kat: SGTM. Please include runbook link in the alert messages. Quick link suggestion: <https://docs.redwood.example/runbooks/gpu-triage|gpu triage runbook>

jordan: And add a cost note — if we start automated cross-region failovers a lot, ops will want to know typical egress / slot cost delta per failover.

mel: Yep — will add a small cost-per-failover calc panel + note in rollout doc. Thanks all :thumbsup:
